name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [release]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Build
        run: ./gradlew clean -Pgroup=com.github.juspay -Pversion=0.0.0-ci -xtest -xlint assemble publishToMavenLocal

name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [release]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version override (e.g. 1.0.1). Leave empty to derive from commit messages."
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Guard branch
        run: |
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/heads/release" ]; then
            echo "::error::Releases can only run from the release branch (got $GITHUB_REF)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        env:
          VERSION_OVERRIDE: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          SEMVER_RE='^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[A-Za-z0-9.]+)?$'

          if [ -n "$VERSION_OVERRIDE" ]; then
            VERSION="$VERSION_OVERRIDE"
            echo "Using manual version override: $VERSION"
          else
            VERSION=$(git tag --points-at HEAD | grep -E "$SEMVER_RE" | sort -V | tail -1 || true)
            if [ -n "$VERSION" ]; then
              echo "Commit is already tagged as $VERSION, resuming that release"
            fi
          fi

          if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
            LATEST_TAG=$(git tag --list | grep -E "$SEMVER_RE" | sort -V | tail -1 || true)
            if [ -n "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
              RANGE="$LATEST_TAG..HEAD"
            else
              RANGE="HEAD"
              LATEST_TAG="0.0.0"
            fi
            echo "Commits since $LATEST_TAG:"
            git log --pretty='%h %s' $RANGE

            # Max bump across all commits in the range; Jira prefixes (BZ-123: feat: ...) are stripped.
            SUBJECTS=$(git log --pretty=%s $RANGE | sed -E 's/^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*//')
            BUMP=patch
            if git log --pretty=%B $RANGE | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*BREAKING[- ]CHANGE'; then
              BUMP=major
            elif echo "$SUBJECTS" | grep -Eq '^[a-z]+(\([^)]+\))?!:'; then
              BUMP=major
            elif echo "$SUBJECTS" | grep -Eq '^feat(\([^)]+\))?:'; then
              BUMP=minor
            fi
            echo "Bump: $BUMP"

            BASE=${LATEST_TAG%%-*}
            SUFFIX=${LATEST_TAG#"$BASE"}
            IFS=. read -r MAJOR MINOR PATCH <<< "$BASE"
            case "$BUMP" in
              major) MAJOR=$((MAJOR + 1)); MINOR=0; PATCH=0 ;;
              minor) MINOR=$((MINOR + 1)); PATCH=0 ;;
              patch) PATCH=$((PATCH + 1)) ;;
            esac
            VERSION="$MAJOR.$MINOR.$PATCH$SUFFIX"
          fi

          if ! echo "$VERSION" | grep -Eq "$SEMVER_RE"; then
            echo "::error::Version '$VERSION' is not valid semver (expected e.g. 1.0.1)"
            exit 1
          fi

          if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$VERSION" >/dev/null; then
            if [ "$(git rev-parse "$VERSION^{commit}")" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]; then
              echo "::error::Tag $VERSION already exists on a different commit"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Tag $VERSION already points at this commit, remaining steps resume idempotently"
          fi

          PREV_TAG=$(git tag --list | grep -E "$SEMVER_RE" | grep -vxF "$VERSION" | sort -V | tail -1 || true)

          echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "prev_tag=$PREV_TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Releasing version: $VERSION"

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Build (mirror of JitPack's command)
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        run: ./gradlew clean -Pgroup=com.github.juspay -Pversion="$VERSION" -xtest -xlint assemble publishToMavenLocal

      - name: Publish to GitHub Packages
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          GITHUB_ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          POM="https://maven.pkg.github.com/juspay/blaze-sdk-android/in/breeze/blaze/$VERSION/blaze-$VERSION.pom"
          HTTP=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -u "$GITHUB_ACTOR:$GITHUB_TOKEN" "$POM" || true)
          if [ "$HTTP" = "200" ]; then
            echo "in.breeze:blaze:$VERSION already exists on GitHub Packages, skipping publish"
          else
            ./gradlew :blaze:publishMavenPublicationToGitHubPackagesRepository -Pversion="$VERSION"
          fi

      - name: Create tag and GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          PREV_TAG: ${{ steps.version.outputs.prev_tag }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "$VERSION" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Release $VERSION already exists, skipping"
          else
            ARGS=(--target "$GITHUB_SHA" --title "$VERSION" --generate-notes)
            if [ -n "$PREV_TAG" ]; then
              ARGS+=(--notes-start-tag "$PREV_TAG")
            fi
            gh release create "$VERSION" "${ARGS[@]}"
          fi

      - name: Trigger JitPack build and wait for it
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          POM_URL="https://jitpack.io/com/github/juspay/blaze-sdk-android/$VERSION/blaze-sdk-android-$VERSION.pom"
          API_URL="https://jitpack.io/api/builds/com.github.juspay/blaze-sdk-android/$VERSION"
          BUILD_LOG="https://jitpack.io/com/github/juspay/blaze-sdk-android/$VERSION/build.log"

          # The first request for the artifact is what triggers JitPack to build the tag.
          curl -sf -m 30 "$POM_URL" -o /dev/null || true

          for i in $(seq 1 60); do
            STATUS=$(curl -s -m 30 "$API_URL" | jq -r '.status // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
            echo "JitPack status: ${STATUS:-pending} (attempt $i/60)"
            case "$STATUS" in
              ok)
                echo "JitPack build succeeded: com.github.juspay:blaze-sdk-android:$VERSION"
                exit 0
                ;;
              [Ee]rror)
                echo "::error::JitPack build failed. Log: $BUILD_LOG"
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
            sleep 30
            curl -sf -m 30 "$POM_URL" -o /dev/null || true
          done

          echo "::error::Timed out waiting for JitPack after 30 minutes. Check $BUILD_LOG"
          exit 1
